newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: LC Development unit sells Solarvest stake.
newsitem.headline: LC Development unit sells Solarvest stake.

text.p: LC Development Ltd, the property arm of Lum Chang Holdings Ltd, said on Tuesday its subsidiary had agreed to sell 700,000 shares in Malaysia's Solarvest Sdn Bhd for 33.5 million ringgit.
The company said in a statement that the agreement was made with Sime Hartanah Sdn Bhd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sime Darby Bhd.

The sale, which represented 35 percent of the issued and paid-up capital of Solarvest, was expected to be completed by January 22 or seven business days from the date of approval from Malaysia's Foreign Investment Committee.
The sale of the shares would result in an extraordinary gain of about Singapore $17 million for LC Development, the statement said.
The sale would increase the net tangible assets per share of the company to S$1.37 from S$1.24 but would have no impact on the earnings per share, the statement said.
